comparisons.scheme1_value: Online via CBSE portal (cbse.gov.in/cbsenew/scholar.html). recommendation: These are two completely different schemes for different life stages and goals. **Choose CBSE SGC if:** You are a meritorious single girl child in classes 11–12, scored 70%+ in class 10, study in a CBSE school, and your family income is ≤Rs. 8 lakh/year. **Choose PM-VBRY if:** (A) You are a first-time formal-sector worker earning ≤Rs. 1,00,000/month and want a one-time incentive of up to Rs. 15,000, OR (B) You are an employer wanting to create additional formal jobs and receive monthly incentives. Both schemes are legitimate; they serve different populations—students (CBSE SGC) vs. workers & employers (PM-VBRY). **Important:** This is AI guidance only.
